sources.title: CMHC Purchase (mortgage loan insurance, homeowner)
sources.publisher: Societe canadienne d'hypotheques et de logement (SCHL/CMHC)
sources.supports: GDS maximum 39 %, TDS maximum 44 %. GDS and TDS calculated at the greater of the contract rate plus 2 % or 5.25 %. Purchase price or lending value must be below $1,500,000. Maximum amortization 25 years (30 years through CMHC Home Start). Premium on total loan: 2.80 % (80.01-85 % LTV), 3.10 % (85.01-90 %), 4.00 % (90.01-95 %), 4.50 % with non-traditional down payment. Premiums are a one-time charge which may be added to the insured loan amount. Worked example: 5 % of $500,000 + 10 % of the portion above.

sources.title: CMHC Home Start: 30-year mortgages for first-time homebuyers or buyers of a newly built home
sources.supports: 30-year amortization available if at least one borrower is a first-time homebuyer or the home is newly built. Premiums: 3.00 % (80.01-85 %), 3.30 % (85.01-90 %), 4.20 % (90.01-95 %), i.e. 0.20 point above the 25-year schedule.

sources.title: What are the general requirements to qualify for homeowner mortgage loan insurance?
sources.supports: GDS includes principal and interest, property taxes, heating, and half of condominium fees; GDS 39 % and TDS 44 % of gross household income; minimum down payment 5 % on the first $500,000 and 10 % above; price below $1,500,000.

sources.title: Minimum qualifying rate for uninsured mortgages
sources.publisher: Bureau du surintendant des institutions financieres (BSIF/OSFI)
sources.supports: Uninsured MQR: the greater of the mortgage contract rate plus 2 % or 5.25 %. OSFI does not expect lenders to apply the MQR to uninsured straight switches at renewal (no increase in amount or amortization). Page modified 2026-01-29; rate reviewed at least annually.

sources.title: Statement by the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Finance on the Canadian housing market (May 2021)
sources.supports: Insured mortgages: minimum qualifying rate is the greater of the contract rate plus 2 % or 5.25 %, for insured mortgages approved on or after June 1, 2021.

sources.title: Guideline B-20: Residential Mortgage Underwriting Practices and Procedures
sources.supports: B-20 sets no numeric GDS/TDS limits: CMHC sets them for insured loans; each lender sets its own maximums in its underwriting policy for other loans.

sources.title: Saving for a down payment and closing costs
sources.publisher: Agence de la consommation en matiere financiere du Canada (ACFC/FCAC)
sources.supports: Minimum down payment: 5 % up to $500,000; 5 % of the first $500,000 plus 10 % of the portion above for $500,000 to $1.5 million; 20 % for $1.5 million or more.

sources.title: Government announces mortgage reform details (September 2024)
sources.supports: Insured price cap raised from $1 million to $1.5 million; 30-year amortizations extended to all first-time homebuyers and all buyers of new builds (effective December 15, 2024).

sources.title: Code du calculateur (calcul refait hors navigateur)
sources.supports: All worked examples were computed by reproducing findMaxAffordable() exactly (semi-annual compounding, 25 years, property tax 1 %/year, heating $150, condo fees x 0.5). Ex. 1: $100,000 income, $500 debts, $50,000 down, 4 % -> 6 %: max $450,000, loan $400,000, premium 3.10 % = $12,400, payment $2,638.56, PITH $3,163.56, GDS 37.96 %, TDS 43.96 %; payment at 4 % = $2,169.31. Same at 5.5 % -> 7.5 %: $405,000 (TDS 43.98 %). $150,000 / $800 / $150,000 / 4.5 %: $737,000 (TDS 43.97 %, no premium). $200,000 / $0 / $30,000 / 4.5 %: $550,000, bound by down payment. FAQ: $500,000 with $25,000 down at 4 %: payment $3,160.64 on $494,000, tax $416.67, heating $150 -> income $114,687; with $100,000 down: $96,181.

claims_needing_review: Calculator code: property tax fixed at 1 % of price per year and heating at $150/month have no cited source; effective residential tax rates in Laval and Montreal should be checked against the 2026 municipal rates.

Calculator code: 30-year amortization is offered to everyone and priced with the 25-year premium; CMHC insures 30 years only through Home Start (first-time buyer or new build) at premiums 0.20 point higher (3.00 / 3.30 / 4.20 %).

Calculator code: the 'estimated monthly payment' shown is computed at the stress-test rate, not the contract rate (example: $2,638.56 shown vs $2,169.31 at the 4 % contract rate). The page text now says so.
Calculator code: 39 % / 44 % limits are also applied to uninsured loans (20 %+ down), where lenders set their own limits under B-20. The page text says so.
OSFI MQR rule (contract + 2 % or 5.25 %) confirmed on the OSFI page modified 2026-01-29; re-check after OSFI's annual December review.
